name: Cannabinol
summary: Cannabinol (CBN) is a mildly psychoactive phytocannabinoid that acts as a low affinity partial agonist at the CB1 and CB2 receptors of the endocannabinoid system (ECS).

pharmacology.text: Each compound acts as a low affinity partial agonist at CB1 receptors with THC demonstrating 5x–10× greater affinity to the CB1 receptor. Like THC, CBN has a higher selectivity for CB2 receptors which are located throughout the central and peripheral nervous system, but are primarily associated with immune function. CB2 receptors are known to be located on immune cells throughout the body, including macrophages, T cells, and B cells.

uses.en: It is sold in some wellness products, often marketed as a sleep aid, though good evidence for this is lacking. It is also studied in cannabinoid research.
uses.zh: 它出現在一些保健產品中，常被宣傳為助眠成分，但缺乏可靠證據支持。它也用於大麻素研究。
uses.zhHans: 它出现在一些保健产品中，常被宣传为助眠成分，但缺乏可靠证据支持。它也用于大麻素研究。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects in people. It is only mildly psychoactive, and drowsiness and dizziness are the effects most often described.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。它只有輕微的精神活性，最常被描述的作用是嗜睡與頭暈。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。它只有轻微的精神活性，最常被描述的作用是嗜睡与头晕。

fact.en: Cannabinol was the first cannabinoid ever isolated, in the 1890s. It forms as THC slowly breaks down with age, heat and light, so old, poorly stored cannabis contains more of it.
fact.zh: 大麻酚是史上第一個被分離出來的大麻素，時間在 1890 年代。THC 會隨著時間、受熱與光照慢慢分解成大麻酚，所以存放已久或保存不當的大麻含量較高。
fact.zhHans: 大麻酚是史上第一个被分离出来的大麻素，时间在 1890 年代。THC 会随着时间、受热与光照慢慢分解成大麻酚，所以存放已久或保存不当的大麻含量较高。
